display.label: Route 53 Hosted Zone
display.description: Create a public or private Route 53 hosted zone to hold DNS records for a domain.

globals.label: AWS Region
globals.description: The AWS region where resources will be provisioned.

resource.key_description: The domain name for this hosted zone, e.g. example.com.

fields.label: Domain Name
fields.description: The domain name for the hosted zone.

sections.label: Type
sections.description: Public by default. Add at least one VPC below to make this a private hosted zone instead.

fields.label: VPCs to associate (private hosted zone)
fields.description: Leave empty for a public hosted zone. Add one or more VPCs to make this a private hosted zone instead.

fields.label: VPC Region
fields.description: Leave blank if the VPC is in the same region set above.

fields.label: Reusable Delegation Set ID
fields.description: Assign this zone a fixed, reusable set of name servers. Public hosted zones only.

fields.label: Force destroy
fields.description: Allow Terraform to delete all records in the zone when destroying it.
